# The two CROSS-PLANE rows are held separately and deliberately, because the SCHEMA CANNOT DECIDE
# THEM. `relation` is a CanonicalIdentifier, not an enum, so no keyword in this document can look up
# which registry that relation belongs to; the oneOf therefore admits either vocabulary on either
# relation. The plane is decided at ADMISSION from registry membership - the same place the
# imported-evidence evidenceDeclarationRule already separates the two planes - and these rows record
# exactly where the schema stops rather than asserting an agreement that does not exist.
